meta.name: memu
meta.description: Give this agent persistent memory via memU. Use to memorize (save files/folders so context survives this session) when the user asks to remember or sync something, or after completing work worth keeping; and to retrieve (search memory from earlier sessions) when the user asks what is known about a person/project/topic or references context not in this conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨会话持久化记忆，自动保存和检索上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同对话间保持agent对项目或人物的记忆
copy.tagline_en: Persist memory across sessions, auto-save and retrieve context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need your agent to remember people, projects, or topics across conversations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以记住你指定的文件或文件夹内容，并在后续对话中检索之前保存的记忆。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 记住或同步某些信息，或者完成值得保存的工作后；或者当你询问关于某人、项目、主题的已知信息，或提到当前对话中没有的上下文时。

say.text: 请记住这个文件夹里的内容。
关于项目 X，我之前保存了什么？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can memorize specified files or folders and retrieve previously saved memories in later conversations.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to remember or sync something, or after completing work worth keeping; or when you ask about known information on a person/project/topic, or reference context not in the current conversation.

say_en.text: Please remember the contents of this folder.
say_en.note: Claude will run memorize-workspace to save.

say_en.text: What do I know about project X from before?
say_en.note: Claude will run retrieve-workspace to search memory.
